n, m = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
import bisect
left_sums, right_sums = [], []
mid = n // 2

def compute_left(i, current_sum=0):
    if i == mid:
        left_sums.append(current_sum)
    else:
        compute_left(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m)
        compute_left(i + 1, current_sum)

def compute_right(i, current_sum=0):
    if i == n:
        right_sums.append(current_sum)
    else:
        compute_right(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m)
        compute_right(i + 1, current_sum)

compute_left(0)
compute_right(mid)

left_sums = sorted(set(left_sums))
best = 0

for val in right_sums:
    pos = bisect.bisect_left(left_sums, m - val)
    if pos > 0:
        candidate = left_sums[pos - 1] + val
        if candidate > best:
            best = candidate
    else:
        if val > best:
            best = val
print(best)
